approval_id.description: The approval request waiting, if one is.

checks.description: A draft's status: ✖ while no signed copy is attached.

drafted_on.description: The day it was drafted: the records it was filled from are that day's.

evidence.description: How many files are attached and not removed: the signed copy. Asking to record it needs one.

fields.description: The fields it was drafted with.

masked.description: true: its fields and text are hidden for your role (the DPO).

paper.description: Its text as filled from the records, as its PDF shows it; hidden when masked.

proposal_id.description: The AI's sec.draft_document proposal it came from, a person having approved it.

recorded_at.description: When it was recorded in the minute book.

recorded_by.description: Who approved it, as it was recorded in the minute book.

signed_on.description: The day it was signed outside Fyniq, as asked to record it in the minute book.

status.description: draft: a paper to review and have signed; recorded: in the minute book with its signed copy, never to change.

template.description: The template it was drafted from, with its version.

version.description: The version of its content; with its status it makes the ETag.
